title: Conan requirement without a recipe revision
description: conanfile.txt declares a requirement pinned to a version but no revision. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a requirement pinned to a version but no revision.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a requirement pinned to a version but no revision.
limitation: It matches a requirement pinned to a version but no revision in the parsed conanfile.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
